title: Towards High-DoF Dexterous Manipulation through VLA Post-Training
authors: Junlei Zhu, Shenzhe Yao, Chaogui Huang, Wenkai Zhu, Jingwei Peng, Guanqi He, Sören Schwertfeger, Jiahao Chen, Yide Liu

tldr.zh: 将手部关节动作编码为低维潜变量，依次进行 VLA 示范微调与平滑人工纠错，再冻结 VLA，通过真机残差 RL 在解码前修正动作，提高灵巧操作可靠性。
tldr.en: Encode hand motions into low-dimensional latents for VLA demonstration fine-tuning and smooth human corrections, then freeze the VLA and learn real-world RL residuals before decoding to improve dexterous execution.

evaluation_scope.zh: 时序 VAE 将每手 20 维动作压为 9 维，双臂 14 维不压缩，形成 32 维接口；编码器与解码器训练后冻结。π₀.₅ 输入三视角 RGB、指令及本体状态，输出 32 步动作块，解码为 54 维关节命令，执行前 25 步后刷新。DAgger 用 5 秒缓冲回退、接管前姿态对齐和 2 秒命令融合收集纠错数据，再训练 VLA。RL 阶段冻结 VLA、解码器及预训练 RL-token 读出器；TD3 残差网络读取 VLA 特征摘要、关节状态和原动作块，在解码前添加有界修正。人工标记成败，在线更新残差与价值网络，不更新 VLA。双 Tianji 七自由度臂＋双 Wuji 二十自由度手完成拾笔、双手交接、手内转笔、拔笔帽和写字，最终各 20 次评测全成功；仅交接和转笔使用 RL，前者 70%→100%、后者 50%→100%，各用 3,000 个动作块交互，非所有任务均走完四阶段。任务专用策略及局部变化评测，不代表统一五任务策略、跨手或大范围场景泛化。代码、数据及权重开放状态未核实。
evaluation_scope.en: A temporal VAE compresses each hand from 20 to 9 action dimensions while retaining 14 arm dimensions, giving a 32-D interface; the codec is then frozen. π₀.₅ reads three RGB views, instructions and proprioception, predicts 32 frames, decodes 54-D joint commands and executes 25 frames per query. DAgger combines five-second buffered rollback, pose alignment and two-second command blending to collect corrections for VLA retraining. During RL, the VLA, decoder and pretrained RL-token readout remain frozen. A TD3 actor reads summarized VLA features, joint state and the reference chunk to add bounded pre-decoding residuals. Human outcome labels train the actor/critics, not VLA weights. Two 7-DoF Tianji arms with two 20-DoF Wuji hands perform marker pickup, transfer, rotation, uncapping and writing; each final policy succeeds in 20/20 trials. Only transfer and rotation use RL, improving 70%/50% to 100% within 3,000 chunk transitions each; not every task uses every stage. These are task-specific policies with local evaluation variations, not demonstrated unified multi-task, cross-hand or broad scene generalization. Code/data/checkpoint release is unverified.
